title: Retire authored-by: one way to say who made a record (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
1. ok. lets retire authored by. 
We have shown that we need this feature, and we should only have one of them. 
2. Yes. We added the Id for a reason in authored-by
3. FIne. 

We are wrong if we find that we need to differentiate between two different actions. But these two don't at the moment so that is a rework anyway. 

Is this the actual principle?   When srs-rust provides a standard way to achieve a goal, we can retire local ways of achieving the same goal.
